ios.desc:
Weather for people with places to be. Forecasts, air quality, and pollen. Everything you need before you walk out the door.

Favorite Features:

Accurate, Actionable Forecasts
• Stay Prepared: The numbers that decide your day come first: temperature, wind, and the chance of rain.
• Minute-by-Minute Precipitation: MinuteCast® tells you the minute rain starts or stops at your exact location. Plan your day with precision.
• Severe Weather Safety: Opt-in alerts for dangerous weather, major storms, and heat waves. You decide what’s worth an alert.
• Detailed Daily Planning: Hourly, 5-day, and 10-day forecasts, so you can plan the week and adjust when it changes.
• RealFeel®: The thermometer doesn't tell the whole story. RealFeel® factors in wind and humidity. Know what to wear for the weather before you're in it.
• Widgets: The forecast before you open the app.
• Light & Dark Mode: Choose the look that works for you, or let it match your phone.

Interactive Radar & Maps
• Live Weather Radar: What's falling right now, on your street or anywhere on the globe.
• Track Storms: See where a storm is headed and when it will reach you.

Air Quality, Pollen & Health
• Air Quality: Real-time AQI, so you can check the air before walking the dog, your commute, or a day outside.
• Pollen Count: Daily pollen counts for tree, grass, and weed, so allergy season has fewer surprises.
• UV Index: Sunburn risk for the day, even when it's cool or cloudy, so you know when to cover up.
• Humidity & Dew Point: A better read on how the air will feel than temperature alone.

Travel & Multi-City Tracking
• Know Before You Go: Add up to 20 cities to your dashboard. Pack for the weather that's where you’ll actually be.
• Multi-City Swipe: One swipe between your hometown, your next trip, and your favorite destinations.
• Airport Weather: The forecast at major airports, so you know the weather at both ends of your flight.

Photography & Design
• Beautiful Photography: Real photos matched to your location, the time of day, and what the sky is doing right now.
• Clean Interface: Open the app, get your answer, go. Nothing between you and the forecast.
• Moon Phase: Tonight's phase, moonrise and moonset, and days until the next full moon.

Accessibility
• Works with your device's built-in screen reader. Optimized for color contrast. Follows the text size you set on your device. 

Helpful Tips
• Scroll Down: For detailed weather information, simply scroll down on the main screen.

android.desc:
Prepare for summer with Yahoo Weather, the app that combines accurate forecasts with photos that match your current conditions. Whether you are tracking a heatwave, checking if it will rain this weekend, or planning your summer vacation, Yahoo Weather helps you stay ahead of the elements. Don’t just check the weather, experience it. Yahoo Weather brings you reliable hourly, 5-day, and 10-day forecasts, ensuring you know exactly when to grab a coat or an umbrella.

FAVORITE FEATURES
Summer Ready Forecasts & Severe Weather Alerts

- Stay Ahead of the Heat: Instantly know what the weather holds with our detailed temperature tracking. We prioritize the data that impacts your day: high winds, chance of precipitation, and changing temperatures.
- Minute-by-Minute Precipitation: Know the exact minute rain starts or stops with MinuteCast®. No guessing if you need an umbrella. Plan your day with precision, whether you have five minutes or an hour.
- Severe Weather Safety: Summer storms can be unpredictable. Get opt-in notifications for daily forecasts and timely alerts for heat waves, hurricanes, and severe weather like thunderstorms to keep you and your family safe.
- Detailed Daily Planning: Check our reliable 10-day forecast to plan your week, from morning commutes to beach trips or backyard BBQs.
- RealFeel®: The thermometer doesn't tell the whole story. RealFeel® accounts for wind and humidity, so you know exactly how to dress before you step outside.

Interactive Radar & Maps
Live Weather Radar: View live interactions and see rain and hurricanes in real-time.

Track Storms: Use our radar maps to see how weather systems are moving across your region. Widen the view to track storms anywhere on the globe with global radar coverage.

Radar Views: Zoom out with radar maps to see the bigger picture of developing weather patterns affecting your area.

Air Quality, Pollen & Health
Air Quality: Track real-time AQI, essential for anyone sensitive to outdoor conditions. Know before you head out whether today is right for a run or a better recovery day.

Pollen Count: Tree, Grass, and Weed pollen counts help allergy sufferers and anyone planning time outside make smarter daily decisions.

UV Index: The sun can be intense any time of year. Track the UV index to know when you need protection.

Humidity & Dew Point: Monitor levels to stay comfortable and protect your health year-round.

Summer Travel & Global Weather
Know Before You Go: Traveling
